run_bn_gen_main: run the self-supervised learning training loop with infoNCE loss and configurable L2 normalization via hydra config
create_Model: create a two-layer ReLU network with K parallel linear filters, optional BatchNorm, and configurable activation functions
create_BatchNormExt: create a customized BatchNorm layer that optionally detaches mean or variance gradients during backpropagation
create_SpecializedL2Regularizer: create a custom autograd function for L2 normalization that divides gradients by the same L2 norms in the backward pass
check_result: check the trained model by projecting weights onto ground-truth token embeddings and computing energy ratio scores
